messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG customization & HIPAA scope checklist — next steps after demo

Hi Elena / Compliance Team,

Thanks again for your time on the demo this morning — appreciated the thoughtful questions about data residency and the encryption model. Per our conversation, we want to get the vendor security questionnaire (SIG) into your hands and clarify HIPAA scope (BAA needs) before we proceed to procurement.

Quick recap and asks:
- We can provide either the full SIG or a trimmed CAIQ-style export. Which format do you prefer for your intake?
- Confirm HIPAA applicability: you mentioned handling PHI in a portion of the workload. Can you confirm whether FinServ Capital will require a BAA for production data, staging, or both?
- SOC 2: Redwood has a Type II report for 2025. Would you like the full report or a bridge letter summarizing controls relevant to data processing?
- Evidence delivery: prefer secure SharePoint / SFTP / vendor portal? We can accommodate any of those.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred questionnaire format and BAA scope.
2) I attach our SIG template and our most recent SOC 2 to this thread for your review.
3) Monica (cc'd) from Security will pick up any technical evidence asks once you send back the SIG cells that you need completed.

Attachments: SIG-template-v2.xlsx, SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf

If you want a short call to walk the questionnaire items, Marissa is available this week to join.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas Weber

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG customization & HIPAA scope checklist — next steps after demo

Jonas — thank you, and likewise for the demo.

Short answers below: we prefer the full SIG (spreadsheet) so our intake team can map controls directly.

HIPAA: production systems will process PHI (claims identifiers, limited patient metadata). Staging may contain de-identified extracts only — we will want the BAA to explicitly cover production; please confirm whether Redwood will sign for both hosted and dedicated deployments (we're evaluating both options).

SOC 2: send the full Type II for now; we may ask for a brief call with your auditor if gaps need clarifying.

Evidence delivery: we prefer SFTP for large artifacts and links for reports. Can you provide an SFTP user or a secure upload token?

Tentative timeline: we are aiming to complete intake and initial risk review by Nov 30. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Elena Rojas
Director, Vendor Risk Management
FinServ Capital

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@finserv.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG customization & HIPAA scope checklist — next steps after demo

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear direction, and welcome — I'll own this from the security side. Short answers and next steps below.

1) BAA scope & deployment models
- Redwood will execute a standard BAA covering production services for both our Hosted API and Dedicated deployments where Redwood manages the inference runtime and key management.
- For fully private/on-prem deployments (customer-managed hardware and KMS), Redwood provides a connectivity and operational addendum but a full BAA signature is typically limited since customer manages underlying infrastructure. If FinServ expects a signed BAA for on-prem, we can assess on a case-by-case basis.

2) SIG / SOC 2 & evidence
- The attached SOC 2 Type II (2025) covers our security and availability controls. That will be sufficient for initial intake. Expect a small set of follow-up evidence requests (e.g., vulnerability scan cadence, EDR vendor slides).
- We will complete the SIG spreadsheet cells you identify as in-scope. To speed this up, please mark the specific question IDs you want completed; otherwise our default approach is to populate all control-level fields and add comments where we provide narrative evidence links.

3) Evidence transfer (SFTP)
- We can provision a temporary SFTP account scoped to FinServ for uploads (valid 30 days), or you can provide an upload token to our secure intake portal. Which do you prefer? If SFTP, we'll send credentials via our secure secrets channel.

4) Timeline
- Nov 30 intake completion is achievable if FinServ returns the SIG (marked fields) by Nov 22. Otherwise we'll aim for the first full week of Dec.

5) Proposed next step: 30-min walkthrough
- I'm available Wed/Thu morning PST for a 30-min call to walk the SIG and call out items that typically require clarification (BYOK/KMS, key rotation, data residency).

Action items:
- Elena: confirm SFTP vs upload token and mark SIG question IDs in the attachment by Nov 22.
- Jonas/Marissa: coordinate the walkthrough time if FinServ prefers a live review.

I'll also attach a short control mapping doc and an internal redaction checklist if that helps limit evidence scope.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer, Vendor Security
monica.patel@redwood.com
